key.name: port
key.description: UDP port the overlay daemon listens on. Must match `port` in the overlay's config.toml; `brainrot install` keeps the two in step.

key.name: overlay-enabled
key.description: The top-bar switch. False keeps the strip off the screen however hard Claude is thinking; every other condition (a Claude Code window in front, actually working) still applies when it is true. Lives here rather than in the daemon's config so it survives a daemon restart and so the panel icon and the overlay can never disagree.

key.name: takeover
key.summary: Hand the keyboard to the overlay
key.description: Chord that lets you drive the scene yourself. Registered inside gnome-shell because a Wayland client cannot register a global hotkey, and grabbed rather than polled so nothing else reads what you type.
